18a.name: Property 18a: Filter Application - Matching Filters
18a.notes: Fixed by using queryAllByText instead of getAllByText for count badges. Also fixed date generation to use integer timestamps instead of Date constructor.

18b.name: Property 18b: Filter Application - No Filters
18b.notes: Fixed by using queryAllByText instead of getAllByText for count badges. Also fixed date generation to use integer timestamps.

19.name: Property 19: Filter State Persistence
19.notes: Fixed by using mockImplementation instead of mockReturnValue to ensure same object reference is returned on every call. Also added mockClear() at start of test to ensure isolation between iterations.

12.name: Property 12: Modal Content Completeness
12.notes: Fixed by using queryAllByText with function matcher to handle edge cases where same text appears multiple times. Performance improved from 30s timeout to ~700ms by waiting for loading overlay to disappear.

13.name: Property 13: Conditional Cancel Button
13.notes: Fixed by waiting for loading overlay to disappear before checking for cancel button. Performance improved from 30s timeout to ~450ms.

15.name: Property 15: Empty State Display
15.notes: Tests that for any day with zero appointments, empty state message displays. Uses getAllByText to handle multiple renders. Also tests that empty state does NOT display when appointments exist.

16.name: Property 16: Calendar Structure Invariant
16.notes: Tests that for any calendar state (loading, error, empty, with data), the calendar must always render exactly 7 day columns. This ensures the calendar structure is maintained regardless of state.
